entries.name: Frontend design
entries.purpose: Distinctive, production-grade web interfaces instead of generic-looking UI
entries.permissions: Instructions only: no scripts, no network access.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Anthropic, Apache-2.0, active repository. Fills the gap between senior-mindset's code rules and the visual quality of a UI.

entries.name: Web app testing
entries.purpose: Test local web apps with Playwright scripts: screenshots, browser logs, UI checks
entries.permissions: Runs local Python scripts with Playwright against a local server; no network beyond the app under test.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Anthropic, Apache-2.0. Complements senior-mindset's testing reference for UI flows; overlaps in part with the Playwright MCP.

entries.name: React best practices
entries.purpose: Performance rules for React and Next.js components and data fetching
entries.permissions: Instructions only: no scripts, no network access.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Vercel, MIT. Proposed only in React or Next.js projects.

entries.name: Web design guidelines
entries.purpose: Review a UI against accessibility and web interface guidelines
entries.permissions: Reads the files under review; may fetch the published guidelines over the network.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Vercel, MIT. A review step that pairs with frontend-design.

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.purpose: The Cloudflare developer platform: Workers, Pages, storage, AI and networking products
entries.permissions: Instructions only; it may suggest wrangler commands, which run only with the user's approval.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Cloudflare, Apache-2.0, active. Cloudflare is senior-mindset's default platform.

entries.name: Wrangler
entries.purpose: Correct use of the wrangler CLI: configuration, deploys, bindings and secrets
entries.permissions: Instructions only; wrangler commands run only with the user's approval.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Cloudflare, Apache-2.0. Proposed when the project has a wrangler config.

entries.name: Workers best practices
entries.purpose: Limits, streaming, error handling and performance for Cloudflare Workers code
entries.permissions: Instructions only: no scripts, no network access.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Cloudflare, Apache-2.0. Reviews Workers code against the platform's own guidance.

entries.name: Web performance
entries.purpose: Audit and improve web performance: Core Web Vitals, loading, caching
entries.permissions: Reads the project; may suggest measurement tools, which run only with the user's approval.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Cloudflare, Apache-2.0. Covers web performance on any stack, not only Cloudflare.

entries.name: DOCX
entries.purpose: Create, edit and read Word documents
entries.permissions: Runs local scripts (Python, Node and LibreOffice for conversions) on the files it is asked to handle; no network access.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Anthropic; the most complete skill for Office files.
entries.exception: Proprietary licence (Anthropic, all rights reserved): it fails criterion 3. Included as an exception by the maintainer on 2026-10-20, because no open skill covers creating and editing Office files as well.
